# Governance

This folder covers the administrative oversight and collaborative development of clinical quality metrics within the Danish healthcare system. It documents the governance actions of the Styregruppen (Steering Committee), specifically its initiative to form a dedicated working group for a new patient nutrition quality indicator in collaboration with the Danish Society for Clinical Nutrition. Because the underlying evidence is currently limited to a single claim regarding this specific working group, the folder provides a focused look at how new clinical metrics are proposed and integrated into the broader quality assessment framework.

## Pages

- [[governance|Governance]] — Details the administrative oversight of clinical quality metrics, specifically the Styregruppen's collaboration with the Danish Society for Clinical Nutrition to develop a new patient nutrition indicator.
